notes: Release date: qwen.ai research index card 'Qwen3.8-Max：编程与办公，全面跃升 | 2026/08/03'; OpenRouter listing 2026-08-03 agrees. Blog migrated to qwen.ai (id scheme: this post is id=qwen3.8; old qwenlm.github.io slugs 404). Table 1 is a DOM table -> all rows verified. A second DOM table (61 multimodal rows: MMMU-Pro 82.3, OSWorld-Verified 86.1, VideoMME 90.4 etc. with columns Opus4.8/Fable5/Gemini3.1-Pro/GPT5.6-Sol/Qwen3.7-Plus/Qwen3.8-Max) also exists on the page - values equally machine-readable but not transcribed in this batch (flagged for follow-up; locator: '模型表现 Table 2'). Long-horizon demos with disclosed numbers: 16-day autonomous oh-my-cli repo (265 commits / 127 PRs / 151 issues, full trace public at github.com/qwen-code-dev-bot/oh-my-cli); 125-hour paper reproduction + self-evolution on AIME24 (reproduced method 49.58%, self-evolved 52.29% = +2.71, 18 ideas over 4 exploration rounds); WWW2025 multimodal dialogue intent challenge: accuracy 0.60 -> 0.853 over 45 submissions in 24h, beating 458 of 526 human teams (87%). RL system disclosed: joint scaling of environments x compute across QwenWork/Claude Code/Codex/OpenClaw/Hermes harnesses; unified reward system (execution-based checks + rubric on text/rendered-visual output + agentic checks); online data balancer per batch. Hundreds of high-value occupation scenario tests (qualitative). Table 1 columns: Opus4.8 | Fable5 | GPT5.6 Sol (max) | Qwen3.7-Max | Qwen3.8-Max.
